claims.claim: All Kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available (shop claim)
claims.evidence: General business claim, not about this specific item; no photo can confirm shop inventory.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: Witness report notes no brand or model markings legible on the part itself, and seller's own intro only mentions Kia/Hyundai stock, creating inconsistency with a Toyota claim.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Not shown: photo only covers one angle; cracks, fogging, and bracket completeness are listed as not visible.

risks.risk: Fitment unknown (make/model/year, left or right side)
risks.proof: Close-up of mounting bracket shape and a label/part-number sticker, plus a shot of the connector side
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment headlight, lowest matching bracket type

risks.risk: Possible internal cracks, fogging, or water damage not visible from current angle
risks.proof: Clear photos of the lens interior from multiple angles and a backlit shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-risk unit, assuming possible internal damage

risks.risk: OEM vs aftermarket authenticity unverified, conflicting with seller's brand claim
risks.proof: Close-up of any embossed logo, part number, or OEM hologram sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket/unbranded, not genuine OEM

risks.risk: Bulb, wiring, and electrical connector condition unknown
risks.proof: Photo or short video of connector pins and a power-on test showing the bulb lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional electrical components, needs replacement

risks.risk: Completeness of clips and brackets claimed but not shown
risks.proof: Photo of the rear mounting area showing all clips/brackets intact

proof_requests: Photo of any part number, logo, or brand marking on the housing or lens
Photo of the rear mounting bracket and all clips
Photo/video of the connector and bulb lighting up when powered
Multiple angle shots of the lens interior for cracks or fogging
Photo showing left/right orientation relative to a reference (e.g., held against a car or with an arrow)
response.reason: Witness confirms it is a used car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at worst case, but the seller's Toyota claim contradicts the shop's stated Kia/Hyundai focus and lacks visible markings, so authenticity and fitment must be assumed unverified until proven.
